name: [PROD] Reschedule Cancel

main.node: Send Owner Ask New Time SMS

parameters.content: Handles inbound SMS for cancel/reschedule (customer-initiated, auto-proposes the next open slot), YES/NO confirmation of a proposed time, and owner-triggered reschedules (owner texts RESCHEDULE LEAD-XXXX to auto-propose a new time to the customer). No manual scheduling — the owner never opens Google Sheets.

main.node: Send Owner Ask New Time SMS

description: Inbound SMS: cancel/reschedule/confirm-yes/confirm-no. Cancel/reschedule unchanged. YES/NO matches pending-confirmation appts, updates Reschedule Status/Attempts, logs to CRM, alerts owner; NO escalates to Manual Follow-Up after 2 attempts.
